problem_statement:
`BasicPolymorphicTypeValidator` setting `allowIfSubTypeIsArray()` should validate element type [CVE-2026-54513]

When constructing `BasicPolymorphicTypeValidator` like so:

```
PolymorphicTypeValidator ptv2 = BasicPolymorphicTypeValidator.builder()
                .allowIfSubTypeIsArray()
                .allowIfSubType(SafeType.class)
                .build();
```

array type validation should also validate the array element type, not just accept array type as-is.
